scope: All36 fresh workers on one frozen checkpoint-derived FP8 linear-layer fixture; includes all results without retries/exclusions.

checks.check: frozen producer, image and hardware identity

detail.scope: This NVL cohort is separate from prior HBM3 measurements.

checks.check: acquisition source, all six fixture slices and original checkpoint QKV linkage
natural file byte chains and paired operand identities
actual retained native binary, all three inputs and build rules

report.scope: Independent source/cache/native audit for the actual static FP8 fused-QKV layer. Includes immutable fixture operands, real quantization, dynamic output/graph evidence, native acceptance, true default versus cold-memory/warm-file paths and unchanged natural persistence. Timing statistics are analyzed separately; no full-model accuracy, serving-throughput or physical-kernel causality claim.

Independent stdlib source/cache/fixture/timing/numerical-evidence audit, without analyzer import or GPU recomputation. Repeated trials on one fixed layer fixture, not pooled timing samples. No full-model or serving-throughput claim.

exploratory_cluster_bootstrap_95_percent.method: exhaustive percentile bootstrap of paired trial units; median statistic

primary_natural_ratios.scope: Natural actual linear-layer path including quantization, dispatch and allocation. Default uses a genuine miss; tuned cold memory and warm file hits differ from that baseline. Graph lookup occurs during capture, not replay.

limits: Each independent unit is a fresh trial triplet on one fixed captured layer/input, not15 worker samples.
Default natural misses and tuned memory/file hits differ; ratios include this dispatch cost.
Quantized-input FP32 gates do not prove dense BF16/full-model accuracy; BF16 error is diagnostic.
Actual linear-layer microbenchmarks do not establish end-to-end serving performance or GPU-kernel identity.

observed_cold_graph_control_gap.scope: Post-tuning graph replay latency; separate from initialization/startup time. Observation is descriptive and is not a validation speedup threshold.

limits: Independent numeric audits verify executed assertion records, guard/error metrics and output hashes; complete nonzero output tensors were not retained for a second numerical recomputation.
Source/build, numerical/cache and mathematical audits overlap; their check counts are not independent experimental samples.
